svg.title: Theo Hsiung
svg.desc: AI for Science, LLM systems and agentic infrastructure. Two alternating scenes: an agent optimizing a liquid-cooling cold plate, pushing the Pareto frontier of thermal resistance and pressure drop; and vLLM Semantic Router inside Claude Code sending each prompt to the right model, masking a secret, and holding a risky Bash command.
